title: An industrial continent
goal: Weigh what industrialisation achieved by the 1960s against its limits, using a pesar de.
grammar: Concession: a pesar de, a pesar de que

items: I can say what Latin America manufactured by the 1960s.
I can explain why the home market was small.
I can say what problems the region still had.
I can explain why some regions developed more than others.
I can admit a difficulty and go on with a pesar de and a pesar de que.
